fields.name: domain
fields.description: Amazon domain ID: 1=United States, 2=United Kingdom, 3=Germany, 4=France, 5=Japan, 6=Canada, 8=Italy, 9=Spain, 10=India, 11=Mexico

fields.name: keyword
fields.description: Title keyword (case-insensitive; spaces mean AND tokenization; wrap keywords containing spaces in double quotes; prefix - for exclusion; & symbol is replaced with space; up to 50 keywords, max 1000 characters)

fields.name: rootCategory
fields.description: Root category IDs (up to 50), only include products in these root categories

fields.name: rootCategoryNames
fields.description: Root category names (up to 50), used when rootCategory is empty; the system automatically looks up corresponding category IDs

fields.name: categoriesInclude
fields.description: Subcategory IDs to include only (up to 50), only include products directly listed in these subcategories

fields.name: categoriesIncludeNames
fields.description: Subcategory names to include (up to 50), used when categoriesInclude is empty; the system automatically looks up corresponding category IDs. Supports full category paths (separated by : or >) for more accurate results

fields.name: categoriesExclude
fields.description: Subcategory IDs to exclude (up to 50)

fields.name: categoriesExcludeNames
fields.description: Subcategory names to exclude (up to 50), used when categoriesExclude is empty; the system automatically looks up corresponding category IDs. Supports full category paths for more accurate results

fields.name: currentSalesGte/currentSalesLte
fields.description: Current sales rank range (lower value = better ranking)

fields.name: avg90SalesGte/avg90SalesLte
fields.description: 90-day average sales rank range

fields.name: deltaPercent90SalesGte/deltaPercent90SalesLte
fields.description: 90-day sales rank change percentage range

fields.name: monthlySoldGte/monthlySoldLte
fields.description: Units sold / monthly sales range

fields.name: srAvgGte/srAvgLte
fields.description: Historical sales rank range (positive integer, lower value = better ranking, used for the month specified by srAvgMonth)

fields.name: srAvgMonth
fields.description: Historical sales rank - selected month (format: YYYYMM, e.g., 202511 for November 2025, within the last 36 months)

fields.name: currentNewGte/currentNewLte
fields.description: Current new price range (in minor currency unit)

fields.name: currentBuyBoxShippingGte/currentBuyBoxShippingLte
fields.description: Current Buy Box price with shipping range (in minor currency unit)

fields.name: currentCountReviewsGte/currentCountReviewsLte
fields.description: Current review count range

fields.name: currentRatingGte/currentRatingLte
fields.description: Current rating range (0.0-5.0)

fields.name: packageLengthGte/packageLengthLte
fields.description: Package length range (mm)

fields.name: packageWidthGte/packageWidthLte
fields.description: Package width range (mm)

fields.name: packageHeightGte/packageHeightLte
fields.description: Package height range (mm)

fields.name: packageWeightGte/packageWeightLte
fields.description: Package weight range (grams)

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Brand (OR match)

fields.name: color
fields.description: Color (OR match), filter products with specified colors

fields.name: size
fields.description: Size (OR match), filter products with specified sizes

fields.name: availableDateGte/availableDateLte
fields.description: Product listing time range (date format: yyyy-MM-dd)

fields.name: buyBoxIsAmazon
fields.description: Whether the Buy Box seller is Amazon

fields.name: buyBoxIsFBA
fields.description: Whether the Buy Box is FBA

fields.name: isHazMat
fields.description: Whether it is hazardous material

fields.name: variationCountGte/variationCountLte
fields.description: Variation count range

fields.name: currentCountNewGte/currentCountNewLte
fields.description: Current new offer count range

fields.name: outOfStockPercentage90Gte/outOfStockPercentage90Lte
fields.description: 90-day out-of-stock percentage range

fields.name: singleVariation
fields.description: Return only one variation; when set to true, multi-variation products will only return one variation

fields.name: productType
fields.description: Product type filter (default [0,1,2]): 0=standard product, 1=downloadable product, 2=eBook, 5=variant parent ASIN

fields.name: history
fields.description: Whether to include historical data / historical sales in the response (1=include, 0=exclude, default 0)

fields.name: rating
fields.description: Whether to fetch rating info (1=fetch, 0=do not fetch, default 1)

fields.name: page
fields.description: Page number (starting from 1, default 1)

fields.name: perPage
fields.description: Maximum results per page (min 50, max 100, default 50)

fields.name: sort
fields.description: Sort (up to 3): array of objects, each containing {"fieldName": "...", "sortDirection": "asc\
